profile_text.body:
Vercel is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, that provides web development infrastructure and tooling. Its primary AI-facing product, v0, is described on the company's own site as a collaborative AI assistant for designing, iterating, and scaling full-stack web applications, with a focus on UI generation.

The held facts note one registered MCP server, app.vercel.agent-svg-registry/mcp, which is described as enabling search of SVG metadata and purchase of licensed commercial SVG exports for coding agents. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for the company at this time.
